title: Tesla Crash Lab | Data-Driven Safety
summary: A short Tesla promotional video touring the company's Crash Lab. It describes using data from the fleet and replicated real-world crash scenarios to engineer vehicle safety.
why: Cited in car-safety threads as evidence that Tesla optimizes for real-world crash data rather than just standardized crash tests.

quote.text: What they claim to do there is to use their real world data to try to optimize for real crashs and not for crash tests.
